notes: Text extraction rendered the 'ff'/'fi'/'fl' ligatures as single Unicode glyphs; they are written as plain letters. No other spelling was changed; source typos are kept (e.g. 'Conservany', 'nagra', 'Pallvan', 'Apartmetns', 'Stree', 'Evacution').

The 84-row 'Water stagnated streets in the previous monsoon - heavy rainfall' table (p.613-618) has pump capacity, pump location and disposal point, so it is in inundation_streets (max_depth and days_to_drain are not given). Rows 75-81 (ward 155) have '-' for pump location and disposal. A merged cell printed in the pump-capacity column reads 'When Adayar river level decreased automatically went to storm water drains.'; it is stored as disposal_point for those 7 rows, with pump=null.

water_stagnation includes: mild-rainfall table (16 rows, p.623), moderate-rainfall table (28 rows, p.623-624), sewer-block table (2 rows, p.625; manhole counts 13 and 31 are not captured), and 'Water Stagnation during previous monsoon (2022-23)' (15 rows, p.624-625). The 2022-23 table gives no rain intensity, so rain=null for those rows. The 2022-23 table's 'Dn' column is the ward (division) number.

Relief centres (p.626-628): the table marks Cooking 'No' for 6 of 8 centres (Yes only for Sri Seethalakshmi Thirumana Mandapam and Rani Mahal), which contradicts the intro text. The table values are used, with column alignment checked against the source PDF. Capacities sum to 1920, matching the intro. Centres 3 and 4 carry '(Now temporarily shifted to their places)' in the name/address column, kept in the name. Centre 2 is listed under ward 144 but its streets say '(Ward 146)'. Contact designations are printed as abbreviations SI / AE / ARO.

A separate 'Flood relief centres identified for previous monsoon' list (p.631, 5 rows: V.P.U. Pallikudda Salai, Nolambur (143); Govt.Hr Sec. School, Shannathi St, Maduravoyal (144); Shri Seethalakshmi Thirumana Mandapam, Maduravoyal (146); Rani Mahal, Nerkundram (148); Govt.High School, Easwaran Koil St, Ramapuram (155)) duplicates centres already in relief_centres, so it was not added again.

Solid Waste Management table (p.603): only Unit-33 has a number (9445191433); the Unit-32 and Unit-34 rows have blank phone cells, stored as phones=[]. The TNSCB contact table (p.609) gives Conservancy Supervisor numbers for all three units (9445191432/33/34).
There are two Mechanical numbers: AEE Mechanical 9840230256 (engineering wing, p.603) and Assistant Engineer, Mechanical 9445190491 (transport, p.635). Both are kept.

Executive Engineer-2 was printed '94451 90031' (with a space) and stored as 9445190031. Landlines '044- 28444973' and '044-24867244' are stored without the space. The TNSCB EE 'Area' cell reads just '14'.
The NDRF Commandant phone is printed '04177 - 246594/246269'. The second number has no printed prefix and is given here as '04177-246269', assuming the shared STD code.

Boats (p.633): two tables. The first gives the stationed location and AE contact with a short area; the second gives the full evacuation-area list for the same wards. They are merged into one boat entry per ward.
